interpretation: Illustrative neutral-input duration, not an empirically established UT counter-strafing mean.

sources.finding: Mean 30 ms overlap among rollover keystrokes in a typing study; not a positive release gap or gaming-specific measurement.
Keyboard features can resolve opposing inputs using last-input priority rather than ordinary simultaneous inputs.

simulation: The same real-time neutral duration is converted to game time for every profile. Release braking acts first, then directional friction and opposite acceleration. Release-specific movement parameters remain unchanged.
